newsitem.title: USA: Trinity Gas moving pipe to Colombia site.
newsitem.headline: Trinity Gas moving pipe to Colombia site.

text.p: Trinity Gas Corp said Friday drill pipe is being transported to the company's Palmira 1 drill site in Colombia, where drilling is expected to begin within 10 days.
The company said contracts are being signed with the Colombian government which will allow Trinity to conduct Cauca Basin operations much like a utility.
"These contracts not only secure exploration and drilling rights," said chief executive Sid Sers. "They also provide a market for the product of drilling operations."

In addition to the Farallones Association Contract, which provides the company with exclusive rights to drill for oil and gas in the Valle del Cauca just outside Cali, Trinity said, it will furnish natural gas, generated electricity and energy fuel for the industrial district in the region.
The Palmira 1 drill site is located in the San Jose Hacienda, the largest privately owned sugar cane plantation in the Cauca Valley.
"Due to recent long-term drought conditions, increased population growth and industrialization, there is a critical need for energy fuel in Colombia," Sers said.
